Checklist and receipt only use short abstract rules. Icons contain their requested grids, but there is no visible layout grid.

sheets.description: Enclosure construction gacha. Exactly 6/5/6 items in 3 rows. Every row2 blueprint has a blue grid and a simple outlined polyomino enclosure shape, no letters. Scale machines larger than crates, hammer smaller. Flat stepped light, no soft glow. Two first-row machines same design with changed pose. Dust and sparkle have visibly different animation stages.

sheets.description: 32 tiles, top-down 3/4, matching prior fences16 materials: warm wood with posts and two rails; cool stone with blocks; dark iron rails and spear tips; gold rails with blue gems. Diagonal segments are straight corner-to-corner 45 degree segments, NOT bent L shapes or straight horizontal fences. Four orientations follow an octagon clockwise upper-left, upper-right, lower-right, lower-left; alternate / and backslash, with consistent front/back depth. Row3 floors completely fill SQUARE native tiles and repeat seamlessly with NO outline; gold stage trim is a repeating floor pattern, not a standalone round object. Row4 objects outlined. Leave generous magenta gutters outside all tiles.

sheets.description: Exactly three rows with 5/8/4 sprites. Chibi characters native16x24, big 8px head, facing LEFT, same style as earlier BbopZOO spring visitors. Pickpocket has dark hoodie, eye mask, small coin sack; same identity across five poses. Walk A/B swap forward foot, run A/B visibly longer strides and stronger lean. Coins, stars and sign stay within each sprite cell. Worker wears khaki zoo uniform/cap, same identity across four poses. No lettering on protest signs or bubbles; blank signs are held, not free-floating. Whole bodies visible, no cropped feet.
